{{Quote|Da Mauler master in da bunker bein' Driton Fitch. More dan likely, he'll have da artifact.|[[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" />}}
'''Driton Fitch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Maulers|Mauler]] who operated out of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Driton Fitch had become a Master of the Maulers,<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> a group of assassins and thugs who followed the teachings of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="CDHZ">[[File:Gal-icon.jpg|14px|link=Sony]] [[CorSec Database H-Z]] on the official ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' website {{C|content now obsolete; [https://web.archive.org/web/20060719111959/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/players/guides.vm?id=80113 backup link]}}</ref> Driton Fitch operated from a [[Mauler Bunker|bunker]] in the [[Lasay Swamp]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Fitch's group had stolen a valuable [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] then sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the Mauler bunker in order to retrieve the Gungan artifact. Several Maulers, including Driton Fitch were killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Driton Fitch was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Driton Fitch was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
